notes: Fixed real-trade proofs being read the wrong way round. Many posts write the values in a different order than the items, for example "Daemon VS Scissors / 153k VS 140k (13k OP ON DAEMON)". The bot read that as Daemonshank paying 13k, when it actually got the 13k overpay. About 1 in 10 proofs had this. Now the item the overpay is "on" or "for" always gets the lower value, and a lowball works the other way. Without such a note, the bot compares each side with the items' values on the trade's day, not today's. Notes in [brackets] and in capitals are now read too. 29 items' usual overpay changed by 2 or more points, mostly up. A proof whose values were fixed shows a note on its card.
